parsed.justification: Rationale A correctly identifies that the comment raises questions (implicit actions) but doesn't directly state an action. However, it somewhat contradicts the rubric, which says clarification questions with direct action implications can be treated as explicit. It also doesn't give a final score, just describes the category. Rationale B correctly identifies the implicit nature of the actions, that they can be inferred, and that they are vague (lacking concrete details on how to implement). It arrives at a score of 2 and aligns well with the rubric.
